title: A new virtualized list needs a test over more rows than one page and one screen
rule: When a component virtualizes a list or reads it page by page (a window over `store.total`, a `want(start, end)` page loader), test it with mock data far larger than one viewport and one page (hundreds or thousands of items): assert that only the window plus overscan renders (the poolSize count), that aria-setsize is the total, and that scrolling past the first page requests the next page's offset and shows its rows by name. A mock with a handful of items renders everything and proves nothing about virtualization or paging.
rationale: E22.2 (#147): the catalog browser's tests used 4 mock families, so rendering every row or a broken page offset past page 0 passed every test.
